name: Electric Motorized Bicycle
description: A two-wheeler with fully operable pedals and an electric motor capable of more than 750 watts that can go faster than 28 mph: a pedaled e-moto. The law counts it as a motorcycle. Defined by N.J.S.A. 39:1-1, added by P.L.2025, c.285 (S4834, signed January 19, 2026).
restrictions: Two wheels, fully operable pedals and an electric motor capable of more than 750 watts
Not a motorized bicycle or low-speed electric bicycle: the definition of motorcycle names it, so motorcycle rules apply
Riders need a motorcycle license or endorsement
Riders and passengers must wear a motorcycle helmet
Titled, registered and insured as a motorcycle
Selling one online is banned until January 19, 2027, a year after P.L.2025, c.285 took effect
Selling a kit that turns a low-speed electric bicycle into one is prohibited
